comment: Arm: narrow -- the conservative direct evaluation-act register only ('is it effective', 'which is better', 'is it worth it', 'compare A with B' and their PT-BR equivalents). Per condition C1 the file carries the evaluation-act row ALONE, so the shipped nine-row competition is out of frame and the offline table exhibits no candidate displacement by construction. Spans are bounded ({0,40}) both for the router's own backtracking rule and because the echoed span lands verbatim in the injected text -- an unbounded span could echo a skeleton element name straight into the treatment. Frozen: the record hashes this file.
